During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] launched an '''attack''' on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Riflor/Legends|Riflor]]. Eschewing a conventional [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] approach, the invaders unleashed a biological weapon on Riflor, devastating ninety-seven percent of the local plant life and resulting in the starvation of millions among the native [[Advozse/Legends|Advoszec]]. The attack rendered Riflor a dead world.<ref name="AdvGamer" />
